mischief.label: Start a rumour
mischief.description: Whisper something juicy about them at the café. True or not, it will travel.
mischief.clue: Two people at the café went quiet when you walked in. One of them was {culprit}.

mischief.label: Anonymous complaint
mischief.description: Send their boss an anonymous complaint. Spelling mistakes optional.
mischief.clue: The complaint mentions things only {culprit} could know.

mischief.label: Let their tyres down
mischief.description: A classic. Petty, quiet, deeply satisfying.
mischief.clue: Your neighbour's camera shows {culprit} crouching by your car.

mischief.label: Steal their idea
mischief.description: Present their brilliant idea as your own before they do.
mischief.clue: Your notes were on {culprit}'s desk this morning.

mischief.label: Publish a fake story
mischief.description: A small, anonymous article. Nobody checks sources anyway.

mischief.label: "Fix" their car
mischief.description: A quick favour at the garage. A slow leak for them.
mischief.clue: The garage receipt has {culprit}'s signature on it.

mischief.label: Send a fake lawsuit
mischief.description: Very official paper. Very scary. Very fake.
mischief.clue: The "law firm" on the letterhead is {culprit}'s home address.
